newsitem.title: ITALY: BCI, Mediobanca deny merger plan.
newsitem.headline: BCI, Mediobanca deny merger plan.

text.p: Italy's Banca Commerciale Italiana and Mediobanca have denied newspaper reports that they were planning a merger.
A statement issued late on Tuesday evening at the request of the stock market regulatory authority, Consob, said a report in Monday's edition of Rome daily La Repubblica was completely unfounded.
Shares in both banks shot up on the Milan bourse on the back of the Repubblica report which said that plans for a merger between the two banks were at an advanced stage.
Mediobanca closed 6.51 percent higher on Tuesday while BCI finished 5.03 percent up on the day.
The statement also said the two banks had asked Consob to investigate the matter.
